summary: Guacamole is a server-side remote desktop gateway that renders desktop sessions directly within a web browser. It acts as an intermediary, translating standard remote access protocols such as VNC and RDP into HTML5-based web traffic without requiring any client-side plugins.
goodFor: It suits administrators who need to provide browser-based access to remote machines across an organisation without installing client software on every local device.
watchOut: The codebase has a moderate maintenance profile and relies on a mix of Java and C components, which might complicate troubleshooting or custom modifications.
deployNotes: You will typically need to run a servlet container for the Java web application alongside the native C daemon, and place the setup behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
